title: Naval Topic 9 生词 · 单词卡

cards.ex: A challenge is something difficult that tests you. You need effort or skill to deal with it.
exs: Speaking English with new clients is still a challenge.
Volume lashes were a big challenge at first.

src.t: There’s a challenge I think, especially if people make very loud public proclamations about things.
src.zh: 我觉得有个难题，尤其是当人们对事情发表非常高调的公开宣言时。

lg: 一道需要用力才能翻过去的坎

cards.ex: A proclamation is a loud, public statement about what you believe or what will happen.
exs: He made a big proclamation that he would never raise his prices.
Be careful with loud public proclamations.

src.t: There’s a challenge I think, especially if people make very loud public proclamations about things.
src.zh: 我觉得有个难题，尤其是当人们对事情发表非常高调的公开宣言时。

lg: 站在高处，大声向所有人宣布。

cards.ex: A hostage is a person who is held and not free to leave. Being a hostage to something means it controls you.
exs: Don't be a hostage to your old opinions.
I felt like a hostage to my phone.

src.t: You mentioned there about, you’re almost a hostage to the things that you used to say.
src.zh: 你刚才提到，你几乎成了自己过去说过的话的人质。

lg: 被绑住、走不了的人。

cards.ex: Used to talks about something that was true or happened often in the past, but not now.
exs: I used to work in an office.
She used to hate mornings.

src.t: You mentioned there about, you’re almost a hostage to the things that you used to say.
src.zh: 你刚才提到，你几乎成了自己过去说过的话的人质。

lg: 以前常这样，现在不了。

cards.ex: To update means to change something so it has the newest information.
exs: I update my price list every year.
Please update the app.

src.t: Being able to update your opinions and change your mind looks very similar to the internet as hypocrisy does.
src.zh: 能更新观点、改变想法，在网上看起来和虚伪非常像。

lg: 把旧的换成最新的版本。

cards.ex: To change your mind means to decide something different from what you decided or believed before.
exs: I wanted classic lashes, but I changed my mind.
It's okay to change your mind when you learn more.

src.t: Being able to update your opinions and change your mind looks very similar to the internet as hypocrisy does.
src.zh: 能更新观点、改变想法，在网上看起来和虚伪非常像。

lg: 脑子里的路牌换了方向。

cards.ex: Hypocrisy is saying you believe one thing but doing the opposite.
exs: Telling clients to rest while I never rest is a bit of hypocrisy.
People hate hypocrisy.

src.t: Being able to update your opinions and change your mind looks very similar to the internet as hypocrisy does.
src.zh: 能更新观点、改变想法，在网上看起来和虚伪非常像。

lg: 嘴上一张脸，背后另一张脸。

cards.ex: Perhaps means maybe. You are not sure, but it is possible.
exs: Perhaps she's stuck in traffic.
Perhaps we can try a softer curl.

src.t: The difference between me saying something in the past and saying something different now is perhaps I’ve learned, perhaps I’ve updated my beliefs.
src.zh: 我过去说的和现在说的不一样，区别也许在于我学到了东西，也许我更新了自己的信念。

lg: 不敢肯定，也许是这样。

cards.ex: A belief is something you think is true.
exs: My belief is that natural lashes look best.
His beliefs changed after he moved abroad.

src.t: The difference between me saying something in the past and saying something different now is perhaps I’ve learned, perhaps I’ve updated my beliefs.
src.zh: 我过去说的和现在说的不一样，区别也许在于我学到了东西，也许我更新了自己的信念。

lg: 心里认定是真的东西。

cards.ex: Legitimate means fair, honest and acceptable, not fake.
exs: Being sick is a legitimate reason to cancel.
Is this a legitimate website?

src.t: But so few people do it in a legitimate way.
src.zh: 但很少有人以正当的方式这样做。

lg: 摆得上台面、站得住脚。

cards.ex: A grifter is a person who tricks people to get money from them.
exs: That online coach turned out to be a grifter.
Don't trust grifters who promise fast money.

src.t: I think that the grifter shill—you’d see this is the smoking gun that shows that he didn’t really believe that thing all along.
src.zh: 我觉得那种骗子、托儿——你会看到，这就是确凿的证据，说明他从一开始就没真正相信过那件事。

lg: 笑眯眯地骗你钱的人。

cards.ex: A shill is someone who pretends to like a product because they are paid to promote it.
exs: Some reviewers are just shills for the brand.
He's a shill for that glue company.

src.t: I think that the grifter shill—you’d see this is the smoking gun that shows that he didn’t really believe that thing all along.
src.zh: 我觉得那种骗子、托儿——你会看到，这就是确凿的证据，说明他从一开始就没真正相信过那件事。

lg: 收了钱假装真心推荐的人。

cards.ex: A smoking gun is clear proof that someone did something wrong.
exs: The text message was the smoking gun.
There's no smoking gun, just rumors.

src.t: I think that the grifter shill—you’d see this is the smoking gun that shows that he didn’t really believe that thing all along.

lg: 枪口还冒着烟——铁证。

cards.ex: All along means the whole time, from the beginning.
exs: I knew all along that she would succeed.
The answer was in front of me all along.

src.t: I think that the grifter shill—you’d see this is the smoking gun that shows that he didn’t really believe that thing all along.
src.zh: 我觉得那种骗子、托儿——你会看到，这就是确凿的证据，说明他从一开始就没真正相信过那件事。

lg: 从起点一路到现在都是。

cards.ex: A retreat is a quiet place or trip where you go to rest, think or learn, away from normal life.
exs: I'm going on a yoga retreat next month.
The company held a retreat in the mountains.

src.t: I went to a retreat in LA a couple of years ago, and there was a guy that I used to follow, a big business and productivity advice content creator, really successful,
src.ft: I went to a retreat in LA a couple of years ago, and there was a guy that I used to follow, a big business and productivity advice content creator, really successful, and he just totally stepped back from everything, went monk mode and focused on his business.
src.zh: 几年前我去洛杉矶参加了一个静修营，那里有个我以前关注过的人，一个做商业和效率建议的大内容创作者，非常成功，后来他彻底从一切中抽身，进入“僧侣模式”，专心做自己的生意。

lg: 躲进安静的地方歇一歇。

cards.ex: Productivity is how much useful work you get done.
exs: My productivity is best in the morning.
Too many meetings kill productivity.

cards.ex: A content creator makes videos, posts or podcasts for people to watch or read online.
exs: She's a lash artist and a content creator.

cards.ex: To step back means to stop being so involved in something, to take a break from it.
exs: I stepped back from social media for a month.
Sometimes you need to step back and rest.

cards.ex: Monk mode means cutting out distractions and fun for a while to focus completely on one goal.
exs: I'm going into monk mode until my exam.
She went monk mode and built her business.

cards.ex: To mention something means to talk about it quickly, without giving many details.
exs: She mentioned a new lash style she wants to try.
Did I mention that we're closed on Monday?
